steps.title: Soave
steps.body: In the 1970s and 1980s, Soave was mass-produced and cheap, giving it a poor reputation. Better producers lowered yields, focused on hillside sites and made more serious wines. Soave Superiore DOCG and Soave Classico Superiore require lower yields and longer ageing. Top Soave can age 10 years or more.

steps.title: Recioto di Soave
steps.body: Recioto di Soave, the region's first DOCG in 1998, is a sweet wine from dried Garganega. Grapes are dried for months on racks, appassimento, concentrating sugar, sometimes with noble rot. The wine is golden, honeyed and sweet, with apricot and almond, balanced by acidity.

steps.prompt: How is Recioto di Soave made?
steps.explanation: Appassimento concentrates sugar in the grapes.

steps.body: Look for Soave Classico from named sub-areas, such as Foscarino or Calvarino. They often show the volcanic, saline side of Garganega.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Soave moved from cheap volume to serious quality
Recioto di Soave is sweet, from dried Garganega
Top Soave can age 10 years or more
